scope: Resolve R1-F7 signing-key placement and R1-F8 T4 authority representation for continued pre-canonical implementation design.

signing_key_placement.signing_runtime_location: host-side deterministic Study-7E test harness outside cFS flight-software applications
signing_key_placement.producer_role: construct/emit or forward signed evidence through the controlled test boundary without storing private signing keys
rationale: Preserves the existing public-key-only cFS verifier/qualifier/decision boundary.
Keeps key-domain compromise separable from producer execution-domain compromise.
Allows F3/F4 key compromise to be modeled by controlled harness access to the targeted test signing key.
Allows F12 execution compromise to alter/drop/rewrite producer behavior without automatically granting signing-key access.
Avoids embedding experiment private keys in cFS flight-software artifacts.
Supports deterministic canonical runs without an external network dependency when the signer is local to the controlled harness.
prohibited: network signing service dependency during canonical execution
private key embedded in verifier, qualifier, decision, sink, or producer cFS binaries
unresolved_before_freeze: exact local IPC/injection boundary between host harness and producer cFS app
final deterministic key-generation procedure and private-key storage path
final test key material and public-key hashes

rationale: RQ2 requires separation of authorization authority as a trust domain, not an additional cryptographic protocol.
A signed opaque authority_id prevents post-signature authority relabeling.
The harness can model F10 authority compromise before producer signing while F1 source compromise remains a later source-stage mutation.
T4 separation is represented by distinct opaque authority-domain IDs and independent harness authority state for primary/corroborator paths.
Avoids adding a second signature/key hierarchy that would confound the intended source/key/authority domain factors.

implementation_semantics.F10_PRIMARY_AUTHORITY_COMPROMISE: harness alters primary authority output before source/producer canonicalization and signing
implementation_semantics.F1_PRIMARY_SOURCE_FALSE: harness/source-stage logic alters the authorization claim after authority output but before signing
implementation_semantics.T0_to_T3: authority IDs may alias according to topology manifest
implementation_semantics.T4: primary and corroborator authority IDs are distinct and driven by independent authority-domain state

unresolved_before_freeze: final opaque authority ID registry values
exact stage-ordered byte transformations for F1/F10/F11/F12
independent audit assertion that topology/fault labels do not enter policy-visible evidence

next_implementation_gate: Implement host-side fixed-width v2 serializer/parser plus deterministic engineering signing/verification tests using non-final test-vector key material. Do not freeze or populate the final experiment key registry and do not bind results to policy features.
